# Consumer price inflation, UK: September 2026

 Price indices, percentage changes, and weights for the different measures of consumer price inflation. 

 Contact: Email Consumer Price Inflation team (cpi@ons.gov.uk) 

 Release date: 21 October 2026 

 Next release: 18 November 2026

...

- The Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) rose by 3.6% in the 12 months to September 2026, up from 3.3% the previous month.
- On a monthly basis, CPIH rose by 0.4% in September 2026, compared with a rise of 0.1% in September 2025.
- The Consumer Prices Index (CPI) rose by 3.5% in the 12 months to September 2026, up from 3.1% the previous month.
- On a monthly basis, CPI rose by 0.4% in September 2026, compared with little change in September 2025.
- Transport, particularly motor fuels, made the largest upward contribution to the monthly change in both CPIH and CPI annual rates; restaurants and hotels made the largest, partially offsetting, downward contribution.
- Core CPIH (CPIH excluding energy, food, alcohol, and tobacco) rose by 3.1% in the 12 months to September 2026, up from 2.9% in August; the CPIH goods annual rate rose from 2.7% to 3.2%, while the CPIH services annual rate rose from 3.6% to 3.9%.
- Core CPI (CPI excluding energy, food, alcohol, and tobacco) rose by 2.8% in the 12 months to September 2026, up from 2.6% in August; the CPI goods annual rate rose from 2.7% to 3.2%, while the CPI services annual rate rose from 3.4% to 3.7%.
